about.description: LiveArt is a blockchain-based platform providing infrastructure for tokenization and on-chain financial services. It enables users to access and trade diverse digital assets through decentralized protocols.
about.registryInfo: LiveArt is a NYC-based tokenization platform for blue-chip fine art and collectibles. Issues NFT-wrapped fractional shares of museum-grade artworks (Picasso, Basquiat, Murakami, Koons, etc.) backed by physical custody at SOC-2 vaults.

fees.revenueNotes: LiveArt earns a structuring fee on each artwork issuance, ongoing custody/insurance fees, and a performance fee on terminal sale. No protocol token.
